decisions.reason: Builds directly on established glass-silicon wafer capabilities and has been on offer since 2018, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Carrier wafer for smaller diameters extends the firm's existing carrier wafer line, requiring little new knowledge.
Copper interposer glass wafer leverages existing glass wafer processing and coating know-how even though copper metallization is newer.
Off-the-shelf brand draws on mature standard wafer products and provides a low-risk adjacent offer.
Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's precision wafer and substrate knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret results and improve the product.
